monday.brief: Find one current crypto development with a surprising fact, concrete number, meaningful change, security event, product launch, or on-chain signal. Build one original post around the strongest fact.

tuesday.brief: Find one practical crypto product, feature, protocol, wallet flow, or tool worth investigating. If no real test exists, propose a safe experiment without inventing results.

wednesday.brief: Find one current crypto, stablecoin, payments, fintech, regulation, adoption, or infrastructure story with a meaningful Africa or Nigeria angle. Avoid assuming all African markets are the same.

thursday.brief: Find one current crypto concept, mechanism, product, or event people may misunderstand. Explain it simply using the strongest current fact.

friday.brief: Find one current crypto development worth watching because of a surprising number, change, launch, risk, adoption signal, or unresolved question. Do not make a prediction.

saturday.brief: Find one current crypto development that can become a safe, educational small-budget investigation. Never fabricate a completed test; frame the $10 angle as proposed unless a real result exists.
